_comment: Weekly event calendar for Your Server Name. dow: Mon=0..Sun=6 (Python weekday). Drives cron AND the website 'upcoming' list. Keep in sync with crontab entries and goon-events.sh keys.

events.title: The Peddler
events.blurb: A stranger with a loaded truck rolls into the hub. Rare stock, cash only, gone within the hour.

events.title: Knox Fog
events.blurb: Cold fog off the river. You won't see them until they're close — and you won't hear yourself think.

events.title: Blood Moon
events.blurb: The moon comes up red as a wound. Every alarm in the county trips at once and the dead wake hungry.

events.title: The Gathering
events.blurb: A tide of the dead, thousands strong, pulls together at one landmark. Break it and earn a place on the wall.

events.title: Double Knowledge
events.blurb: The Syndicate pays double all weekend — every swing, stitch and page is worth twice as much until Monday.

events.title: Wanted
events.blurb: A price goes up on one Goon's head. Collect at the Ledger — if you can catch them.

events.title: Supply Drop
events.blurb: A bird drops a crate somewhere over the county. Everything you need and things you don't. First there keeps it.

events.title: Bandit Siege
events.blurb: A bandit column moves on a town, armed and coming. Defenders split the pot.

events.title: Siren Saturday
events.blurb: An hour of escalating dread — gunshots pull hordes, the chopper shadows someone, thunder sells the mood.

events.title: The Purge
events.blurb: For one hour the old rules are off. Safehouse doors mean nothing and bounties pay double. Settle your debts.
